Em-dash '—' correctly rendered for null closing balance in the statements grid (confirmed on 25 rows at 768 and 1440); no stray comma bug.
Row-level Link wrapper preserves data-testid statement-row-<id> / invoice-row-<id> and navigation works on phone (verified end-to-end).
